messages:
jamie: Kicking off Lighthouse Health POC scoping. They require a HIPAA-ready DPA, SOC2 evidence (summary + extract), a vendor pen-test plan, and a short evaluation suite to validate clinical summaries. Targeting a 4-week pilot starting mid-May. Who can take compliance, infra, evals, and pricing? @maria @alex @sam @ryan

lauren: I'll coordinate the customer side (legal and engineering liaisons). They asked for data residency in eu-west-1 and confirmation we can redact PHI before storing.

alex: I can handle infra and the private endpoint options. Need to know expected QPS and avg seq len. Important: if they send PHI to hosted endpoints we must document KMS + TLS details and our retention/deletion workflow. For a VPC trial we'll need an IP allowlist and short-lived creds.

maria: I'll prepare a DPA redline (HIPAA-capable template) and a SOC2 cover memo. We can share a SOC2 Type II extract under NDA. Pen-test: we can either share our vendor details or let Lighthouse run their own tester against our non-prod environment. Need scope (external vs. auth'd tests).

sam: I'll design the evals. Proposal: 3 core clinical flows (discharge summary, med reconciliation, triage note) with ~40 gold examples each plus 20 adversarial prompts. Metrics: BLEU/ROUGE for content overlap (but human-reviewed), hallucination flag rate, safety/PHI leakage checks, and p95 latency. I'll provide a pytest harness + scoring script.

ryan: Pricing: hosted dev POC — $1,500 flat + metered tokens at 60% of list; Private/VPC trial — refundable reservation $4,500 for 2 weeks (includes priority infra and support). I'll put these in a short SOW. Any objections?

jamie: Sounds good. Key acceptance criteria we should propose: 1) Clinical summary accuracy >= 80% on core flows (human-evaluated), 2) Hallucination <= 7% on clinical QA, 3) p95 latency < 400ms on dev load, 4) No critical findings from pen-test, 5) Data deletion confirmed within 30 days. Agree?

maria: Add encryption at-rest details (KMS integration options) and clarify that if they require HSM-backed keys that pushes to Private deployment. Also specify logging/audit extracts we can provide for SOC2 evidence.

alex: For pen-test scoping I'll draft a network diagram, list of endpoints, and a short sample of requests (redacted) so the vendor can size tests without seeing PHI. If Lighthouse insists their tester runs against customer-managed infra, timeline will stretch.

lauren: Lighthouse legal (cc'd) prefers our DPA before any sample data exchange. They'll sign NDA to get SOC2 artifacts. They also asked about expected turnaround on pen-test findings 1 business days after test completion? Is that reasonable?

maria: Yes 10-15 business days for our initial remediation report. If findings are critical we'll triage faster with on-call eng.

sam: Eval prompt example to include in harness: ```
Prompt: "Summarize the patient's ED visit focusing on abnormal labs and recommended follow-ups."
Scoring: Compare to gold summary; deduct points for invented diagnoses/meds; require inclusion of any red-flag vitals.``` I'll attach the rubric.

jamie: Deliverable checklist to include in the SOW: DPA template, SOC2 cover memo (under NDA), pen-test scope & timeline, network diagram, data handling SOP (ingest/redaction/retention), eval harness + rubric, pricing & payment terms, and proposed acceptance criteria. Target to assemble docs in 5 business days.

ryan: I'll draft the pricing clause and a short cancellation/refund term for the reservation.

alex: I'll upload the network diagram and redaction checklist by Tue.

maria: I'll have the DPA draft and SOC2 extract request ready in 5 business days; sec-bot plz stage artifacts to secure share when ready.

sec-bot: Staged: dpa_lighthouse_v1.pdf, soc2_extract_2025.pdf at https://secure.redwood.internal/files/1966123456

jamie: Great. Lauren will send Lighthouse contacts and legal timeline. If anyone hits a blocker on the 5-day turn, flag here. Thanks team :thumbsup:
